Kaspersky Details Three Ransomware Attacks on VMware ESXi and Proxmox VE Using Poorly Protected Credentials

Kaspersky researchers detailed three ransomware attacks involving VMware ESXi and Proxmox VE that relied on poorly protected credentials.
